name: Crossley four-stroke gas engine production
description: Crossley Brothers made Otto four-stroke internal-combustion gas engines in Manchester under acquired rights.

places.note: Present-day country or region reference; ancient political boundaries are not implied.

events.statement: Crossley Brothers in Manchester produced Otto four-stroke gas engines after acquiring the relevant rights.
events.caveats: Production year does not establish the first sale, unit volume or the origin of all four-stroke concepts.

evidence.supports: Science Museum history states 1876 rights and replacement production from 1877.
